findings.text: blocking: copying the live log and later truncating it loses any access lines systemd appends in that interval; _LOG_ROTATION_LOCK excludes other rotations but cannot exclude stdout or stderr writes, violating the per-request log goal under concurrent traffic.

follow-on: the regex already admits only nonnegative digits, so this assertion and line 98 cannot fail on a negative duration; the test also accepts duplicate access lines and never compares the header and logged values, leaving those regressions undetected.
